## Included Dependencies

All vendored dependencies are either GPL-3, GPL-2 + Later, BSD-3 or MIT. If you are the owner of one of these dependencies and would prefer it to not be vendored here, please reach out via:

https://iamlamprey.com/contact

#### NAM:
NeuralAmpModelerCore A2 reference implementation: https://github.com/sdatkinson/NeuralAmpModelerCore/
JSON: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/
xsimd: https://github.com/xtensor-stack/xsimd 
math_approx (0.3b & below): https://github.com/Chowdhury-DSP/math_approx  
RTNeural (0.3b & below): https://github.com/jatinchowdhury18/RTNeural  
RTNeural-NAM (0.3b & below): https://github.com/jatinchowdhury18/RTNeural-NAM  

#### TRANSPOSE:

Rubberband (0.3b & below): https://github.com/breakfastquay/rubberband

#### ASIO (Windows):

ASIO SDK: https://www.steinberg.net/developers/prorietary-sdk/
Important: Do NOT include the ASIO SDK in the Projucer directory.
